remarks: Introducing The Green Nook Condominium, a beautifully renovated and redesigned custom condo that offers a sophisticated, contemporary style unmatched in modern expression and luxurious living. The Green Nook is one of two stunning side-by-side condos proudly introduced by our premier builder, GreenDay Construction.  This 2024 renovated condo is filled with natural light and features a modern open floor plan interior with elegant, luxurious details. The three-bedroom condo is professionally designed and includes modern comforts while maintaining a timeless and graceful feel due to the classic hardwood floors, paint colors, new lighting, and cabinetry featured throughout. All bathrooms have also been exquisitely renovated and redesigned.  The completely renovated kitchen includes chef-favorite new appliances, an island that flows into the dining room, and a bright, sun-filled living room with a wood-burning fireplace.  No detail has been left untouched, as the passion for beauty is evident in every element of this light and bright location condo. The condo features touches ranging from traditional to contemporary to modern-all perfectly infused with relevant choices that integrate a casual luxury lifestyle, incredible attention to detail as only a top-notch builder/designer can bring to life.  Experience this new condo complex as the perfect home with convenient access to shopping, dining, and the metro north.
